shortDescription: AUSTIN, Texas, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Asure Software, Inc. NASDAQ:ASUR today announced that the number of job applications submitted to employers through Asure Recruiting is on track to exceed a record 1 million in 2026 and that its HR consulting engagements have continued to increase in…

children: today announced that the number of job applications submitted to employers through Asure Recruiting is on track to exceed a record 1 million in 2026 and that its HR consulting engagements have continued to increase in 2026. Asure announced the milestones as it celebrates the independent businesses honored on Small Business Saturday, Nov. 28.

Recruiting software and HR consulting give Asure two ways to help employers beyond payroll. Employers can manage job postings and applications through Asure Recruiting and turn to Asure’s HR consultants for help with workplace policies and compliance. Asure serves more than 100,000 clients across the United States, both directly and through reseller partners.

Hiring remains active across the economy. According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Employment Situation report released Nov. 6, private-sector employers added 159,000 jobs in October, the latest month available, and total nonfarm payroll employment rose by 165,000. Private-sector job gains have averaged 126,000 per month over the past three months, and the unemployment rate was 4.1%.

“When an independent business owner, like those celebrated on Small Business Saturday, needs to hire, every hour spent sorting applications is an hour away from running the business,” said Pat Goepel, Chairman and CEO of Asure Software. “We help owners manage hiring and get practical HR advice when they need it. That’s how we can do more for the employers who already count on us for payroll.”

American Express founded Small Business Saturday in 2010, and the U.S. Small Business Administration has co-sponsored it since 2011. According to an American Express consumer survey cited by the SBA, shoppers spent an estimated $18 billion at local merchants on Small Business Saturday in 2025.

Asure Software provides cloud-based payroll, HR, recruiting, time and attendance, benefits administration and payroll tax management solutions. Its enterprise payroll tax and treasury services support tax filing across jurisdictions, funding and money movement. For more information, visit www.asuresoftware.com.
